brokers.name: Acxiom
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: CPPA-registered data broker (confirmed present as 'Acxiom LLC' in the 2026 CPPA registry CSV export). Full profile access/deletion runs through the AboutTheData.com consumer portal, which verifies identity with last-4 SSN and DOB before showing a profile.
brokers.notes: Acxiom is a B2B/marketing data broker with no public people-search tool (publicly_searchable=false is deliberate). A simpler marketing-suppression-only web form exists at https://www.acxiom.com/optout/ (also documented at https://isapps.acxiom.com/optout/optout.aspx) and does not require an account, but only the AboutTheData.com identity-verified account flow reaches full profile deletion, hence account-required. Also reachable by phone at 1-877-774-2094. Acxiom states it responds within ~2 days but full compliance can take the statutory 30 days. captcha_required is not confirmed from sources for either path; set to false pending live verification. Owner listed per CPPA registry entity name; ultimate parent is The Interpublic Group of Companies.

brokers.name: Epsilon
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: CPPA-registered data broker (confirmed present as 'Epsilon Data Management, LLC' in the 2026 CPPA registry CSV export). Recognizes Global Privacy Control (GPC) as a valid opt-out-of-sale signal in applicable states.
brokers.notes: Consumer Data Subject Request portal at legal.epsilon.com/dsr supports opt-out-of-sale/share, opt-out of profiling/ADM, and full deletion (deletion is a separate selection from opt-out, which by default only flags records Do-Not-Share rather than deleting). Phone alternative: 1-866-267-3861. captcha_required not confirmed from sources; set to false pending live verification. Not a public people-search site.

brokers.name: LexisNexis Risk Solutions (Personal Records Suppression)
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Large consumer-risk data broker; treated here as CA-registered based on its scale and inclusion alongside Acxiom/Epsilon/CoreLogic in industry summaries of major CPPA registrants, though this session's direct CSV lookup did not return a 'LexisNexis' row (the CSV is large and the fetch tool may truncate/summarize rather than exhaustively search it) — flag for live re-verification. Suppression from restricted public-records products has an expedited path for law enforcement, public officials, identity-theft victims, and domestic-violence survivors.
brokers.notes: Two distinct tiers exist: (1) a general consumer-disclosure opt-out/request at consumer.risk.lexisnexis.com/opt and /optrequest, and (2) formal 'Information Suppression' requests (the stronger, restricted-public-records-product suppression) which require documentation substantiating physical-risk or identity-theft-victim status, uploaded via optout.lexisnexis.com or mailed/emailed if upload isn't possible. Mail fallback: LexisNexis Individual Requests for Information Suppression, PO Box 933, Dayton, OH 45401; email privacy.information.mgr@lexisnexis.com. Classified as id-upload because the fullest suppression path routinely requires document upload; captcha_required assumed true for the online consumer risk portal but not directly confirmed — verify live. No public consumer search tool (used by subscriber businesses, not consumer-facing search).

brokers.name: CoreLogic (Cotality)
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Rebranded from CoreLogic, Inc. to Cotality, Inc. in 2025 (references to 'CoreLogic' in older opt-out guides now redirect to cotality.com). Treated as CA-registered given its scale and inclusion in industry summaries of major CPPA registrants, but this session's CSV lookup did not directly confirm a 'CoreLogic'/'Cotality' row — flag for live re-verification.
brokers.notes: IMPORTANT scope limitation found in sourcing: CoreLogic/Cotality's self-service CCPA request forms are explicitly restricted to 'HR Data Subjects' (current/former applicants, employees, contractors of Cotality) and 'B2B Data Subjects' (business contacts who interacted with Cotality in a B2B capacity) — there is no confirmed general-consumer opt-out for its property/consumer data products for people outside those categories. Requests: HR Data Subject Request Form or B2B Data Subject Request Form at cotality.com/legal, or call 1-800-634-4149, or email datasubjectrequests@cotality.com. QuietLine should flag to the user that a standard consumer removal request may be declined as out-of-scope; this needs live verification before submission.

brokers.name: MyLife
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Confirmed CA data broker registrant ('MyLife.com, Inc.', historical CA OAG data broker registration on file at oag.ca.gov/data-broker/registration/539822).
brokers.notes: Notoriously difficult in practice despite a nominally simple web form: submit profile URL, name, city, state, zip, email at mylife.com/privacyrequest, solve a CAPTCHA, then click a confirmation link sent by email (request is not active until confirmed). Multiple independent guides report the stated 10-15 day timeline frequently stretching longer, with follow-up by email (support inbox referenced inconsistently across guides, not confirmed to a single clean address so omitted here) or phone (1-888-704-1900) often needed. Data commonly reappears because MyLife continuously rescrapes public records. This is a public reputation/people-search site (publicly_searchable=true).

brokers.name: Experian Marketing Solutions (Consumer Data Opt-Out)
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: CPPA-registered data broker (confirmed present as 'Experian Marketing Solutions, LLC' in the 2026 CPPA registry CSV export, distinct from the FCRA-regulated 'Experian Information Solutions, Inc' credit-bureau entity). This entry is scoped to Experian's marketing/consumer data broker business, NOT the credit report or credit-freeze product.
brokers.notes: Consumer Privacy Application portal (consumerprivacy.experian.com/request) handles marketing-data opt-out and access requests; processing up to 30 days. Separate/additional path: opting out of prescreened credit/insurance offers is done jointly across bureaus at optoutprescreen.com or 1-888-567-8688, not through this portal — that joint prescreen opt-out is a distinct mechanism from this marketing-data opt-out and is not this entry's primary target. Email alternative: optout@experian.com. Phone: 833-210-4615. captcha_required not confirmed from sources; set to false pending live verification. Not a public people-search site.

brokers.name: TransUnion (Consumer Privacy / Marketing Data Opt-Out)
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: A TransUnion-affiliated entity ('Datalink Services, Inc', per a general CPPA-registrant search this session, reportedly a TransUnion trading/legal name; this mapping is not independently confirmed against the live registry and should be re-verified) appears as a CPPA data broker registrant. This entry is scoped to TransUnion's marketing/data-broker privacy-choices product, NOT the credit report or credit-freeze product.
brokers.notes: Consumer Privacy Rights page (transunion.com/consumer-privacy) lets consumers opt out of sale/sharing and targeted advertising without creating an account; also reachable by phone at 866-310-8783 for opt-out (opt-outs processed daily) or up to 45-90 days for full access/correction/deletion requests. Separate joint prescreen opt-out at optoutprescreen.com / 888-567-8688 covers preapproved credit/insurance offers and is a distinct mechanism from this entry. captcha_required not confirmed from sources; set to false pending live verification. Not a public people-search site.

brokers.name: Innovis
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Not found in this session's CPPA registry CSV lookup. Innovis is a nationwide consumer reporting agency (CRA); CRA activity regulated under the FCRA is generally carved out of California's data broker definition, which may explain the absence — treat ca_registered as unconfirmed rather than a confident 'not registered', and re-verify live.
brokers.notes: Primary consumer-facing path documented across sources is the toll-free joint opt-out line 888-5-OPT-OUT (888-567-8688), shared with Experian/Equifax/TransUnion for prescreen marketing lists, which is why this entry is classified phone-verification; a 5-year opt-out can be completed online at optoutprescreen.com or via Innovis's own web form at innovis.com/personal/optOutOptIn, but a PERMANENT opt-out requires Innovis to mail a Notice of Election that the consumer must sign and mail back — i.e., the durable option is not self-service online. captcha_required not confirmed; set to false pending live verification. Not a public people-search site.

brokers.name: Persopo
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Not found in this session's CPPA registry CSV lookup; corporate parent/registrant name could not be confirmed from available sources (site itself just identifies as 'Persopo'), so treat ca_registered as best-effort rather than confirmed.
brokers.notes: Site has a page at persopo.com/opt-out.html but multiple independent guides describe the actual working mechanism as: find your listing, copy the profile details shown in the search-result preview (without clicking into the full profile), and email them to optout@persopo.com with 'Opt-Out Request' in the subject line; postal alternative: Opt Out Department, 848 N. Rainbow Blvd., Suite 20, Las Vegas, NV 89107. Phone: 1-800-481-9168. Typical turnaround 10-20 business days. Recommend using a disposable email address per multiple guides' advice, since data brokers have been known to add opt-out senders to marketing lists.

brokers.name: SearchQuarry
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Not found in this session's CPPA registry CSV lookup; treat as unconfirmed rather than definitively unregistered and re-verify live. Site references privacy rights applicable to CA, CO, CT, DE, IN, IA, KY, MD, MN, MT, NE, NH, NJ, OR, RI, TN, TX, UT, and VA residents.
brokers.notes: Opt-out flow: from the homepage footer, use the 'Exercise My Privacy Rights' link (also documented at members.searchquarry.com/opt-out), search by first/last name plus state/city, select the matching record, click 'Remove Data', supply an email address, complete the CAPTCHA, and submit; a confirmation email with a link must be clicked to finalize the request (request is not processed without it). Most requests process in 48-72 hours per vendor-side guides, occasionally up to a week. Database refresh cycles mean reappearance is common.

brokers.name: PublicRecordsNow
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Not found in this session's CPPA registry CSV lookup; corporate parent/registrant name not confirmed from available sources, so treat ca_registered as best-effort rather than confirmed.
brokers.notes: Web-form opt-out at publicrecordsnow.com/static/view/optout/ (also reachable via a 'click here to opt out' link on the site's contact page): enter first/last name, city, and state matching the listing, solve a CAPTCHA, and submit; typical turnaround 7-14 days per guides though some report 24-72 hours. Multiple independent guides note PublicRecordsNow draws on / shares data with PeopleFinders and Intelius, so a PublicRecordsNow opt-out alone may not suppress those separately-owned listings — verify whether this creates overlap with the PeopleConnect network entries (peoplefinders/intelius) already covered elsewhere in the registry before treating a single opt-out here as sufficient. One source also flagged the site's Contact Us page / opt-out reachability as inconsistent at times of checking; re-verify the live URL before relying on it.

brokers.name: PublicDataUSA
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Not found in this session's CPPA registry CSV lookup; corporate parent/registrant name not confirmed from available sources, so treat ca_registered as best-effort rather than confirmed.
brokers.notes: No static opt-out URL could be sourced: guides consistently describe finding your listing via name+state search, copying the result-page URL, then using a 'Remove My Information' link embedded at the bottom of the search-results/profile page (not a fixed top-level path), where you paste the URL, name, and email, then complete a CAPTCHA. opt_out_url is set to the homepage because no more specific sourced URL exists; do not fabricate a deeper path. Typical turnaround reported as 3-10 days. Free by law; multiple guides warn never to pay a 'removal fee' some third parties advertise for this site.

brokers.name: VoterRecords.com
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Not found in this session's CPPA registry CSV lookup; corporate parent/registrant name not confirmed from available sources. Underlying voter-roll data itself is public record maintained by state/county election officials, so an opt-out here has no effect on the government's own records — only on this site's republished copy.
brokers.notes: No fixed top-level opt-out URL was found; the FAQ page (voterrecords.com/faq, used here as opt_out_url since it is the sourced, real URL documenting the process) explains that each individual record page has its own 'Record Opt-Out' link at the bottom, leading to a per-record form requiring full name and email plus a CAPTCHA, followed by an email confirmation link (some users report no confirmation email is sent when the record processes automatically). Opt-out removes house number, phone number, and email contact fields only — name, general location, party affiliation, and voting history may remain visible per the site's own FAQ. Reappearance within 3-6 months is explicitly called out across guides due to periodic data refreshes.

brokers.name: Kochava
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Confirmed CA data broker registrant (a CA OAG 'Data Broker Registration for Kochava Inc.' record was located directly at oag.ca.gov/data-broker/registration/192405). Kochava is a mobile/location advertising data broker, not a people-search or public-records site; subject to a November 2025 FTC settlement requiring a sensitive-location 'privacy block' and a consumer opt-out/blacklisting mechanism.
brokers.notes: IMPORTANT mechanism mismatch versus QuietLine's usual name/phone/address flow: Kochava's opt-out/do-not-sell page requires the consumer to submit their device's Mobile Advertising ID (MAID) rather than name or address, and requests are device-specific (each device/MAID must be submitted separately). QuietLine's discovery flow should surface this to the user rather than attempting a standard PII-based submission. Full data-deletion requests can alternatively be emailed to privacy@kochava.com or requested by phone at 855-562-4282. captcha_required not confirmed from sources; set to false pending live verification. Not publicly searchable — no consumer-facing lookup tool exists.

brokers.name: Equifax (Marketing / Non-Credit Data Opt-Out)
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: CPPA-registered data broker: both 'Equifax Information Services LLC' and 'Equifax Workforce Solutions LLC' were confirmed present in the 2026 CPPA registry CSV export. This entry is scoped to Equifax's marketing/non-credit data use (promotional mail, prescreened offers, phone solicitations), NOT the credit report or credit-freeze product.
brokers.notes: myPrivacy portal (myprivacy.equifax.com/opt-in-opt-out/personal-info) takes name and address (DOB/SSN/email/phone optional to speed matching), requires a CAPTCHA, and is stated to process within 15 days. Mail alternative: Equifax, P.O. Box 1025, Atlanta, GA 30301. Separate joint prescreen opt-out for preapproved credit/insurance offers (shared with Experian/TransUnion/Innovis) is at optoutprescreen.com / 888-567-8688 and is a distinct mechanism from this marketing opt-out. Opting out here does not delete or affect the underlying credit file. Not a public people-search site.
